page_title: REN 0-0 LEN | Rennes v Lens 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+2' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) is penalised.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Rennes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
85' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) is given a yellow card.
85' The game is interrupted. Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
85' A cross from a corner kick by Rennes is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

84' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Robin Risser, who tips the ball around the post. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
83' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Quentin Merlin as he is replaced by Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes).
78' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Ruben Aguilar is replaced by Saud Abdulhamid (Lens).
76' Brice Samba leaps like a salmon to deny Adrien Thomasson (Lens), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.
75' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for an infringement.
71' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) fires a wonderful strike towards goal, but it's a whisker wide of the right post.
71' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Brice Samba sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net.
70' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) receives a cross on the edge of the box. He doesn't hesitate and fires a bullet towards the goal. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper had no trouble dealing with his shot.
69' Great solo effort from Rayan Fofana (Lens)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post.
68' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
68' Nordan Mukiele (Rennes) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The referee blows his whistle, Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
67' Florian Thauvin crosses the ball right onto the head of Morgan Guilavogui (Lens), but his firm header from around the penalty spot shoots well wide of the right post.

65' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
65' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
64' Florian Thauvin (Lens) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
63' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) gets a yellow card.
62' Ludovic Blas goes off the pitch and Nordan Mukiele (Rennes) comes on.
62' The substitution has been made. Mohamed Meite (Rennes) has replaced Breel Embolo.
61' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Wesley Said and he is replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
61' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Odsonne Edouard will be replaced by Rayan Fofana (Lens).
60' Anthony Rouault (Rennes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
60' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
59' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!
58' Florian Thauvin (Lens) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
55' The corner from Florian Thauvin (Lens) is hurriedly cleared.
55' Lens force a corner. They send men into the box.
54' Breel Embolo (Rennes) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
49' Fine attempt! Mousa Tamari (Rennes) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
48' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
47' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
47' The Rennes players keep hold of the ball by exchanging some long passes. One inaccurate pass, however, surrenders possession. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.

43' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
40' The whistle blows and Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is booked for an infringement.

39' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
36' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
35' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play and Lens manage to earn a corner.
33' Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight and sees a foul from Adrien Thomasson (Lens).
29' Substitution. Djaoui Cisse walks off the pitch and Mousa Tamari (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.

29' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save.
27' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lens.
26' Lens couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Brice Samba (Rennes) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
26' Bastien Dechepy blows the whistle, Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) is penalised for a foul.
23' A decent cross gives Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
17' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
16' A raking crossfield pass from Matthieu Udol (Lens) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
13' Florian Thauvin (Lens) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
12' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

8' That was close by Adrien Thomasson (Lens)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
7' A cross by Florian Thauvin (Lens) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
3' Seko Fofana (Rennes) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
2' Looks like Seko Fofana (Rennes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
1' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) can have an early bath after being sent off by the referee for a tackle that simply has no place in football!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
